levels.name: Gångtunnel (pedestrian tunnel)
levels.note: The 2011 plan calls the tunnel existing and planned to extend it to a new commuter car park north of the yard; OSM has an underpass (w310276089, layer -1) reaching platforms 1–3. Whether it is still the passengers' route to the platforms is not stated by any owner source.

open: Lifts: no source (Jernhusen, Västtrafik, municipality, OSM) mentions a lift to the footbridge or tunnel; whether the island platform 2–3 has step-free access is unknown.
Whether the gångtunnel (OSM w310276089) is still in passenger use, or only the footbridge: not stated by an owner source.
Stationscaféet opening hours: not on Jernhusen and no own website found.
Platform numbering beyond OSM (1, 2, 3; Wikipedia: 2 platforms, 3 tracks) not confirmed by a plan.
